text: On time. Packaged well. Used it with a 4inch elbow on vent from dryer and a 4 inch elbow to the outside. Seems to be working fine with no leaks.
Also works well for making bulk batches. Not into making coffee every morning, so I use this to filter into a pitcher. Very good at removing grinds.

It works. Cleaning problems? Just rinse it with hot water right after using. Don't set it aside to get crusty! Rinse the hot water tap onto it from the OUTSIDE to push the crud back out from how it came in. Quick & easy. Makes good coffee with mouth feel.No nasty paper flavors. Yum.
Works perfectly.  I will purchase product again when needed.

Addicted to caffeine? Need a way to quit? This is the product for you! A combination of frustration, and fear that you're going to break your keurig will get you started. Then to top it off your brand new filters will break leaving you steaming mad and ready to face the week with the gumption to yell at Toby in HR on Monday instead of the usual Tuesday

Work well on 3 mil mylar bags.  I bought several gallon size bags and this is wide enough to do these size of bags.  All you need to do is set the dial to the bag thickness in mils, put you bag over the bottom portion of the sealer, close to top handle and wait until the light goes out.  It only takes a couple of seconds.  The width of the seal is only about an 1/8" or so but appears to be adequate but as an extra measure I doubled sealed mine.  This surely beats using an iron to seal bags.

The replacement "clear Choice" water filter installed just fine, and ice maker works great.....end...!  The filtered water does not come on and it has been at least a month and still no water..!!  Not the filters fault but it seems that all these double door GE refrigerators have this problem. Googled the problem and 90% said that the water line has frozen..!  All gave their version of how to clear the water line. I have not gotten to the fix as yet.

Great little machine, we use it for our travel trailer and it works very well. Found out that having enough water level is key to ensuring that clothes swirl correctly in the washer tub. I just love my Della Ice Maker! After washing the basket, scoop, and the inside of the machine all you have to do is plug it in, put water in it, turn it on and select the size ice you want. It just starts cranking it out. I am an ice cruncher and this ice isn't as hard as what you buy in the bags or make in ice trays which I love because it's much gentler on my teeth.
this is a great machine.
After following all instructions, the ice maker made 8 cubes over 2 hours and then refused to make any more.  Clearly I got a defective unit as others seemed to have considerably more luck (and ice).
This was a gift for my son........he is happy with it.
Followed the direction to let it sit upright for over 24 hours and we love it!!! It's a lifesaver since our ice machine in our freezer is broken.
Works great .

I LOVE MY DELLA ICE MACHINE. I did what some suggested about letting it set after taking it out of the box for the refrigerant fluid to resettle properly. I have made sure there's plenty of air space around it. And everyday I get two - two gallon bags of ice. I'd probably get more but I use ice all day long. If I had a complaint it would be the basket being small. But I really can't say that I get a 32 Oz container of ice per basket full. I recommend this machine.
